title: PigBlade
description: A simple mod that enhances pigs with new details and features, making them more fun and visually appealing while staying true to the original game style
body:
This resource pack transforms all pigs in the game into true symbols of royalty by adding a crown inspired by Technoblade 👑. It is a simple yet iconic change that gives your world a unique and fun touch without altering the original gameplay.

The pack is fully vanilla, which means you do not need to install any mods, OptiFine, or additional add-ons. Just download it, activate it in the resource pack menu, and all pigs will instantly appear with their new crowned look.

The texture has been carefully edited directly onto the original pig model, keeping the classic Minecraft pixel art style so it blends perfectly with the rest of the game. It is also very lightweight and does not affect performance, making it ideal for any computer.

This project also serves as a small tribute to Technoblade, keeping his legacy alive in a simple but meaningful way 🩸👑.

If you have ever wanted to see pigs rule the world in style, this pack is for you. Enjoy your new pig kingdom.
